Can I edit the text in the generated story layouts?
Yes! Lovart's 'Text Edit' feature allows you to click on any text in the AI-generated image and change the wording, font, or correct typos instantly.
Does Lovart generate videos for Stories?
Absolutely. You can use the 'Video Generator' tool powered by Seedance 2.0 to create 5-10 second vertical videos perfect for Instagram Stories and Reels.
Are the images copyright-free for commercial use?
Yes, all assets generated by Lovart on paid plans come with a commercial license, allowing you to use them for your brand or client projects safely.
How do I make sure the layout fits the 9:16 aspect ratio?
Simply select the '9:16' ratio in the settings or mention it in your prompt (e.g., 'Instagram Story format'). Lovart's Agent creates specifically for vertical mobile screens.
Can I upload my own product photos?
Yes. You can upload your product photo and ask Lovart to 'place this product in a luxury living room setting' or 'create a story layout using this photo'.
